mapper.select: SELECT FROM workspace_model_configs m WHERE m.workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND (m.created_by=#{userId} OR m.default_model=TRUE) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members wm WHERE wm.workspace_id=m.workspace_id AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE') ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.created_by=#{userId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN m.default_model=TRUE THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.updated_at DESC, m.id DESC

SELECT FROM workspace_model_configs m WHERE m.workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND (m.default_model=TRUE OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members owner WHERE owner.workspace_id=m.workspace_id AND owner.user_id=m.created_by AND owner.status='ACTIVE' )) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects p JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=p.workspace_id WHERE p.id=#{projectId} AND p.workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE') ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.created_by=#{creatorId} THEN 0 WHEN m.created_by=#{userId} THEN 1 WHEN m.default_model=TRUE THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, m.updated_at DESC, m.id DESC

SELECT FROM workspace_model_configs m WHERE m.id=#{id} AND m.workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND (m.default_model=TRUE OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members owner WHERE owner.workspace_id=m.workspace_id AND owner.user_id=m.created_by AND owner.status='ACTIVE' )) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects p JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=p.workspace_id WHERE p.id=#{projectId} AND p.workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE')

SELECT FROM workspace_model_configs m WHERE m.workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND m.enabled=TRUE AND (m.default_model=TRUE OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members owner WHERE owner.workspace_id=m.workspace_id AND owner.user_id=m.created_by AND owner.status='ACTIVE' )) ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.created_by=#{creatorId} THEN 0 WHEN m.created_by=#{userId} THEN 1 WHEN m.default_model=TRUE THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, m.updated_at DESC, m.id DESC

SELECT FROM workspace_model_configs m WHERE m.id=#{id} AND m.workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND (m.created_by=#{userId} OR m.default_model=TRUE) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members wm WHERE wm.workspace_id=m.workspace_id AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE')
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace_model_configs SET name=#{name},provider=#{provider},model_id=#{modelId},endpoint=#{endpoint},auth_type=#{authType}, credential_ciphertext=COALESCE(#{credentialCiphertext},credential_ciphertext),config=CAST(#{config} AS jsonb), enabled=#{enabled},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND created_by=#{createdBy}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM workspace_model_configs WHERE id=#{id} AND workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND created_by=#{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace_model_configs SET default_model=FALSE, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND default_model=TRUE
UPDATE workspace_model_configs SET default_model=TRUE, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND created_by=#{userId} AND enabled=TRUE
